label: mcl_core_diorite_smooth
reference_prompt: Create a close material reference for diorite deliberately cut and smoothed by old stoneworkers in a grounded dark-fantasy world. The original interlocking pale and dark mineral grains remain visible, but grinding has flattened rough crystal relief into a broad matte plane. Fine abrasion, softened grain boundaries and occasional shallow tool variation should show workmanship without erasing geology. Use muted off-white, cool gray and restrained charcoal grains. Avoid glossy granite countertops, terrazzo, featureless white slabs or machine-perfect polish. The finished material should feel architectural and carefully worked while unmistakably remaining natural diorite.
